_comment: Copy to pb.config.json (gitignored) and put your own Pixelblaze's address in it. pbz searches up from the current directory first, then its own install directory, so a project can keep its own copy. --host=… and $PB_HOST override this.
_expect_comment: Optional. `pbz config --check` asserts every key here against the device's live settings and exits non-zero on drift. Worth pinning whatever, if it silently changed, would make your patterns render wrong: colorOrder and pixelCount are the usual two.
